opening.argument: The presentation urges viewers to buy packages immediately and start mining coins, pairing that demand with projected profits of 55 to 110 times their coin’s value. It promotes OneCoin as a business opportunity through signup appeals and paid education packages tied to token production, reinforced by bonus claims, future coin values and urgency. Those inducements establish the scam: speculative appreciation is used to encourage immediate purchases. The chart expressly identifies its values as predictions, so the figures remain projected gains, not established outcomes.
